name: Hierarchical Voxel Traversal
definition: A recursive raycasting algorithm that traverses a hierarchical voxel structure (chunks containing subvoxels) to find intersections. It handles nested voxel data by transforming rays into local subvoxel space when entering a detail voxel.
summary: Hierarchical Voxel Traversal is a recursive raycasting algorithm that efficiently traverses nested voxel structures by transforming rays into local subvoxel space upon entering detail voxels.
